title: Trade review 06 Nov: 8 results, 5 lessons
summary: 1 T2 (HDFCLIFE +6.09%), 1 T1 (CPPLUS), 1 failed (GNA −7.35%), GRANULES partial −0.24%. Partial-win fix re-scored 55 closed trades to +168.7%.
body_md:
**Trade review, Fri 6 Nov:** HDFCLIFE closed at T2, CPPLUS hit T1, GNA failed at 30 days (a retest), GRANULES closed flat, 2 missed winners.

Nifty rose 2.0% to 25,030.35. The partial-win fix is now live: half of a partial win sells at T1 and half at the 30-day close. That re-scored the 5 earlier partial wins from +18.6% to −0.7% in total, so all 55 closed trades now total +168.7% (average +3.1%), against +189.4% from 52 last night. The average of all 101 bought trades slipped to −0.03% (+0.5% last night), mostly from the re-scoring, and 26 of 46 running trades are below their buy price (23 of 48 last night). Monday has nine 30-day exits, most of them deep under water: GKSL (−17.6%), GMMPFAUDLR (T1 booked, −17.2%), QUADFUTURE (−16.9%), NRBBEARING (−16.9%), BALAMINES (T1 booked, −13.5%) and SYNCOMF (−13.2%).

**Today's results**
- ✅✅ **HDFCLIFE** (Pullback, listed 22 Oct): T2 hit, trade closed: Bought at ₹528.35 on 23 Oct, T1 was reported last night, sold ₹560.53 today after 14 days, +6.09%; worst dip −3.84%. It traded 3.3% cheaper inside the entry window, and a zone-bottom buy at ₹513.40 would have made +9.18%. Pullbacks have the best T1 rate of any style (21 of 25).
- ✅ **CPPLUS** (Retest, listed 15 Oct): T1 hit, still open: Bought at ₹4,100.10 on 16 Oct, half sold at T1 ₹4,343.32 today after 21 days (+5.93% on that half, because T1 is set from the zone top), back from a −11.73% dip; now +0.76%. It traded 5.9% cheaper inside the entry window. It is only the 11th of 31 retests to reach T1.
- 🟢 **NMDC** (Candle at support, listed 4 Nov): bought: Listed 1.6% above the zone, dipped in and filled at the zone top ₹68.80 today; now +2.33%. An F&O stock in a lagging sector.
- ✅ **GRANULES** (Pullback, listed 6 Oct): partial win, trade closed: Bought at the zone top ₹828.43 on 7 Oct, T1 was reported on 27 Oct, then it slid. Half sold at T1 ₹853.28 and half at the 30-day close (about ₹799.66), net −0.24% after 30 days; worst dip −8.08%. A 'win' that lost money. It traded 2.3% cheaper in the window; zone bottom only would never have filled. It is back on today's list as #1, a candle-at-support pick with a lower zone (₹782.05–805.51).
- ➖ **GODFRYPHLP** (Candle at support, listed 3 Nov): not bought, missed winner: It came within 1.3% of the zone and never dipped in. A buy up to 2% above the zone (₹1,734.33) or at the next open (₹1,735.00) on 4 Nov would have reached T1 that day and later T2, but only as a +3.9% gain, because the targets are set from the zone top. Trigger volume was 5.7×, the group that often fails to fill.
- ➖ **VBL** (Candle at support, listed 3 Nov): not bought, missed winner: It came within 2.3% of the zone. A next-open buy at ₹408.00 on 4 Nov would have reached T1 that day and later T2, a +3.24% gain.
- ➖ **FRACTAL** (Candle at support, listed 3 Nov): not bought: It never came closer than 5.3% to the zone and ran as far as 19% above the zone top, so no entry rule would have bought it. Trigger volume was only 0.11×.
- ❌ **GNA** (Retest, listed 6 Oct): failed at 30 days: Bought at the zone top ₹609.76 on 7 Oct, never traded above the fill and closed at ₹564.95, −7.35% (worst −18.82%), 4.6% below its ₹592 support. The listing chart shows what the score (8) missed. ₹592 was the July spike high that capped the price through August and September; then a burst of heavy volume took it to the ₹648 52-week high in a few days, and on listing day it was already fading back to ₹592 on ordinary 1.0× volume. T2 (₹646.35) sat right under that ₹648 wall, and the stock carried an ASM warning. It is another spike-then-fade retest like SMLMAH, YATHARTH and ACMESOLAR, which the retest change now keeps off the list. Zone bottom only would have softened it to −4.57%, not avoided it.

Plus 35 earlier, among them ANTHEM, NLCINDIA, JSWINFRA, BALKRISIND and SANSERA (4 Nov), BRITANNIA, FLUOROCHEM, ALKEM and MCX (3 Nov), the six 2 Nov T2 closes and the five earlier partial wins. These 45 wins (39 at T2, 6 partial) made +255.6%; with the 10 failures (MANINDS −24.56%, SMLMAH −18.63%, WABAG −12.47%, YATHARTH −9.56%, ACMESOLAR −8.42%, GNA −7.35%, CENTUM −7.15%, and three liquid ETFs at +0.29% to +0.46%) all 55 closed trades total +168.7%. 3 of the 45 'wins' lost money: ELLEN −4.97%, WOCKPHARMA −2.97% and GRANULES −0.24%. T1 booked, rest still open (22): today CPPLUS; 5 Nov SUNDARMFIN, IDFCFIRSTB, WAAREEENER, BANKINDIA, KOTAKBANK, TMPV, TATAPOWER and ENGINERSIN; 4 Nov ASTRAL; 3 Nov EMAMILTD; 2 Nov ONGC; 28 Oct PNGSREVA, KROSS and ESCORTS; earlier LANDMARK, URBANCO, GMMPFAUDLR, MARKSANS, BALAMINES, BBOX and ROSSTECH. 11 of these 22 are back below their buy price.

**Missed and better entries**
- **Missed winners now 16 of 23:** GODFRYPHLP and VBL (both 3 Nov) are new, above. 15 of the 23 never bought came within 2% of the zone. Tonight's two show the catch: the alternative buys were close to T1, so the wins would have been only +3.9% and +3.2%, not +6%.
- **Zone up to 2% higher: more fills, but the money lead is gone:** Fills 93% vs 81% as listed: 12.7 points (the bar is 15). Its 68 closed trades made +173.2%, against +168.7% from 55 as listed, with 12 losing trades against 10. Before the partial-win fix it led +236.0% to +189.4%.
- **Next day's open dips less:** Worst dip −6.6% vs −7.7% as listed, 1.1 points shallower (the bar is 2); its 69 closed trades made +205.0%, with 9 losing trades.
- **Near misses: it is the room filter, not the top-10 cut:** 84 of 116 near-miss buys reached T1 (72%) against 67 of 101 real buys (66%), and 56 reached T2 (48% vs 39%). Correction to last night: 103 of the 116 are stocks dropped by the room-under-6% filter (a wall within 6%) and only 2 come from ranks 11–20. None is 30 days old yet (the oldest was logged 14 Oct), so none can have failed; their money can be compared from about 13 Nov. No retest setups have appeared since the change (none on 4–6 Nov).

**Lessons**
- **Retests fill almost always, but they lose money (now off the list):** Their 31 trades average −4.4% (closed and open), against +1.9% for the other 70. 7 of the 10 failures were retests (GNA today), and their 12 closed trades net −45.4%. Off the list since 4 Nov. (holding)
- **Pullbacks reach T1 most often:** 21 of 25 bought have reached T1 (84%, against 78% for candle-at-support) and 13 reached T2 (52%). After the partial-win fix their 17 closed trades made +83.9% with 2 small losses (GRANULES −0.24%, WOCKPHARMA −2.97%), so 'none lost money' no longer holds. (weakening)
- **(missed) Support picks that never dip into the zone are often winners:** 16 of 23 never bought would have reached T1 at the next open (GODFRYPHLP and VBL new tonight); 15 of the 23 came within 2% of the zone. Those buys are often close to T1, so the wins are small. (holding)
- **Very high trigger volume (over 2.5×) often means no fill, and a bad fill:** 7 of 13 filled (54% vs 78% for all picks; GODFRYPHLP at 5.7× missed tonight); those that fill dip −10.2%. (holding)
- **(missed) The room-under-6% filter leaves winners out:** 73 of its 103 near-miss buys reached T1 (71%) against 66% for real picks, and 47% reached T2 against 39%, for the fifth review in a row. None can fail until mid-November. Renamed from 'the top-10 cut' (only 2 near misses came from ranks 11–20). (holding)

Still true but out of the top 5: picks already in the buy zone at listing always fill (45 of 45). Early signs, not lessons yet: candle-at-support picks have 20 of 40 at T2 (50%), +113.4% from 22 closed and the shallowest dip (−4.3%). F&O stocks reach T2 about twice as often as cash stocks (49% vs 25%) and dip far less (−3.4% vs −11.5%).

**Proposed change:** No change tonight. The closest candidate is the room-filter lesson: its near misses reach T1 and T2 more often than real picks, but none of them is 30 days old, so none can have failed and the money can't be compared until about 13 Nov. Buying up to 2% above the zone is 12.7 points ahead on fills (the bar is 15) and no longer makes more money. Next-open buys dip 1.1 points less (the bar is 2). The retest change has been live for 3 days.

**🐞 Bug check:** the partial-win bug is fixed. Partial wins now sell half at T1 and half at the 30-day close, and the 5 earlier ones were re-scored (ELLEN +3.00% to −4.97%, WOCKPHARMA +3.96% to −2.97%, KIRIINDUS +3.00% to +1.26%, GESHIP +4.03% to +2.38%, SAILIFE +4.58% to +3.66%). That is the fix working, not a price revision. LIQUID1 stayed at +0.46% for a second night. Nothing new: 101 bought = 39 at T2 + 6 partial + 10 failed + 46 running, T1 hit 67 ≥ T2 hit 39, no dates out of order, no duplicates (GRANULES is listed again today as a new pick), every closed return matches its fill and exit, and no fill revisions.
